title: Datadog Application key (legacy 40-hex): one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39 hex characters vs the corroborated 40 and length: 41 hex characters (one extra hex byte at offset 20) vs the 40 both pinned tools and Datadog's validators corroborate. Twin of "Datadog Application key (legacy 40-hex): must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
